guides: Pass data to ONE ArticleComp using hard-coded props in App.js
Define a const articlesList with at least 3 article objects
ADD (don't delete the previous article) the other articles to the DOM. Map over articlesList to render an ArticleComp for each item
Add a unique key prop to each rendered ArticleComp from the articlesList so React works correctly
tips: You can use the flowerUrl variable to pass the image to the ArticleComp
In ArticleComp you only need to change the ArticleProps type
